standard.summary: 将 latent 缓存持久化到磁盘，跨训练 run
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Persists the latent cache to disk so it survives across training runs.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 将 latent 缓存持久化到磁盘，跨训练 run 复用。适合大数据集或多次反复训练同一批数据。

advanced_en.principle: Persists latents to disk for reuse across training runs. Good for large datasets or repeated training on the same data.
